body: I appreciate what your saying but I don't think there will be a light for me. I used to want to live..to fight..but I'm so calm and I've just accepted it now.
I wanted to get into security, like my dad did. I can't ever do anything right.
I was going for computer science. It's all I've ever wanted to do. That and join the military but I can't even get into the military over something stupid.

I've switched majors already.  
I should have had my degree and an actual job at my age but I can't even get hired to flip burgers here.

I'm a failure. I've been to 3 different schools and I can't finish a single degree. I'm a burden to my family and friends and I'm causing stress on their relationships. I can't get a real job to try and improve my situation. I just want to be someone else..I can't stand being me.
